title: Payola and the disc jockey who could break a record
summary: Disc jockeys and program directors expected money; Ridgley describes a DJ who could break records and the flip side Pretty Little Mama.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship
